#   name      the release name
#   source    history: the collection history of a copy of the server's database (names only)
#             feed: a public feed (SubsPlease, nyaa.si), read 2026-10-07
#             example: a made-up name that shows one reading
#   work      the work's title as the name writes it (a rule's match phrase), - for none
#   episode   12, 12.5, batch, batch 1-12, or - for no episode
#   version   the revision, 1 for a name without one

#             predicted (the episode past-search judging and the episode-offset preview predict for
#             a video file, which is not the episode in the name the worker gives it; checked
#             for every video line, "no episode" on both sides counting as equal)
